item.title: Pentesting as a Service: 10 Top Pentesting Service Providers (2026) As cyber threats evolve, organizations use penetration testing to stay ahead, and this guide spotlights 10 top providers—like BugCrowd, Deloitte, and Mindgard—offering expert services across industries and technologies.
item.description:
Author: Fergal Glynn
Date: January 09, 2026
Tags: ["Cybersecurity", "Penetration Testing", "Information Security", "Risk Management", "IT Compliance"]
Summary:
  • Pentesting helps organizations identify security weaknesses early.
  • Top providers include BugCrowd, Deloitte, and Mindgard.
  • Providers offer services for AI, mobile, and cloud security.
  • Choosing the right provider requires checking expertise, reputation, and methodology.
  • Compliance, cost, and innovation are also key factors.
  • Effective pentesting improves overall security posture.

item.title: Data annotation as the foundation of reliable AI systems
Why AI Agents need RBAC?
item.description:
Author: Alessandro Pignati
Date: January 09, 2026
Tags: ["Artificial Intelligence", "Cybersecurity", "Access Control", "Identity and Access Management", "Enterprise Security"]
Summary:
  • AI agents act much faster than humans.
  • Their decision-making is probabilistic, not fixed.
  • Traditional RBAC fails to control AI actions properly.
  • AI agents need precise rules and boundaries.
  • Current IAM models are inadequate for AI governance.
  • New RBAC paradigms must suit autonomous AI agents.
